revisions.title: A crowned rhapsode meets a curious layman
revisions.body: Ion arrives fresh from a first-prize victory at Epidaurus and is bound for the Panathenaea. Socrates praises the rhapsode's art while specifying its task: interpreting the poet's thought, not merely his words. Ion readily accepts this standard and ranks himself above every Homeric interpreter.
